senior-application-support-engineer.title: Senior Application Support Engineer
senior-application-support-engineer.summary: Own complex L2/L3 production incidents, troubleshoot APIs, databases, and infrastructure, and improve application reliability through automation and DevOps practices.
senior-application-support-engineer.metaTitle: Senior Application Support Engineer | FEKRA Careers
senior-application-support-engineer.metaDescription: Apply for a Senior Application Support Engineer role at FEKRA. Remote in Egypt, 6-month full-time contract. L2/L3 support, SQL, APIs and automation.
description: About the role

FEKRA is looking for a Senior Application Support Engineer to provide hands-on L2/L3 production support for business-critical applications, investigate complex technical issues, and drive continuous improvements in operational reliability.
This is not a traditional ticket-based support role.

We are looking for an engineer who can independently troubleshoot production problems across applications, APIs, databases, operating systems, infrastructure, and integrations, taking full ownership of incidents from investigation through resolution and root-cause analysis.

The ideal candidate combines strong technical troubleshooting skills with practical experience in scripting, automation, and DevOps practices. A proactive approach to learning new technologies and exploring AI-assisted tools to improve operational efficiency is highly valued.
Position details:
Location: 100% Remote — Egypt
Employment: Full-time contract
Contract Duration: 6 months
Experience: 4+ years (5+ preferred)
Start Date: Immediate
Working Days: Sunday to Thursday
Salary: Competitive, based on experience
What you will do
Provide hands-on L2/L3 production application support for business-critical systems.
Take ownership of complex production incidents, from initial investigation to resolution, root-cause analysis (RCA), and preventive actions.
Troubleshoot application issues across logs, REST/SOAP APIs, databases, integrations, operating systems, infrastructure, and backend application logic.
Perform SQL-based investigations, data validation, and troubleshooting across relational and NoSQL databases.
Diagnose API authentication, connectivity, payload, response, integration, and timeout issues.
Support applications running on Linux and Windows Server environments, including IIS, Windows Services, and application servers.
Support production deployments, release validation, configuration changes, rollback procedures, and Docker-based applications.
Work with Git, CI/CD pipelines, monitoring platforms, logging systems, and operational tools.
Collaborate with development, DevOps, infrastructure, database, network, and business teams to resolve production issues.
Monitor application health, performance, service availability, and operational alerts.
Identify repetitive operational tasks and develop automation using Python, Bash, PowerShell, APIs, or similar technologies.
Explore AI-assisted tools for troubleshooting, log analysis, scripting, documentation, and incident management, while validating outputs before production use.
Maintain incident documentation, operational runbooks, troubleshooting guides, and knowledge articles.
Communicate incident status, technical findings, and resolutions clearly to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
Continuously improve application reliability, operational processes, and incident response efficiency.
requirements: What we are looking for
Required qualifications
4+ years of hands-on experience in Application Support, Production Support, Application Operations, SRE, DevOps, Integration Support, or a similar production-focused role.
Proven experience supporting business-critical applications in live production environments.
Strong L2/L3 troubleshooting skills across application logs, APIs, databases, integrations, operating systems, and infrastructure.
Strong SQL knowledge and practical experience investigating production database issues.
Hands-on experience with REST APIs, JSON, Postman, and API troubleshooting.
Understanding of SOAP APIs and enterprise system integrations.
Good understanding of backend application behavior, with the ability to investigate application logic during incidents.
Experience supporting Linux and Windows Server environments.
Hands-on experience with application deployments, release validation, configuration management, and rollback procedures.
Experience with IIS and/or Windows Services.
Practical exposure to Docker and containerized applications.
Experience using Git, CI/CD workflows, monitoring, logging, and observability tools.
Practical scripting or automation experience with Python, Bash, PowerShell, or similar technologies.
Ability to demonstrate real examples of operational tasks personally automated or improved.
Solid understanding of incident management, root-cause analysis (RCA), SLAs, and production ownership.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder-management skills.
High learning agility and a proactive interest in automation, DevOps, and AI-assisted operational improvements.
Preferred qualifications
5+ years of relevant production application support experience.
Experience supporting .NET and/or Node.js applications.
Experience with Oracle, PostgreSQL, MySQL, MongoDB, or SQL Server.
Familiarity with Kubernetes, OpenShift, or other container orchestration platforms.
Experience with Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD, GitHub Actions, Ansible, or similar tools.
Familiarity with ELK/Elastic Stack, Kibana, Grafana, Prometheus, Dynatrace, or other observability platforms.
Cloud operations experience with AWS, Azure, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, or similar platforms.
Experience supporting large-scale, highly available, or integration-heavy production systems.
Experience delivering measurable improvements through automation, incident reduction, or operational optimization.
What makes you successful
You investigate problems independently rather than relying on ticket escalation alone.
You understand how applications, APIs, databases, operating systems, and infrastructure interact.
You take ownership of production issues and follow through until they are properly resolved.
You actively identify opportunities to automate repetitive tasks and improve operational efficiency.
You can quickly learn unfamiliar tools, technologies, and application environments.
You communicate clearly under pressure and collaborate effectively across technical teams.
You combine a strong production support mindset with curiosity about DevOps, automation, and emerging AI technologies.
benefits: Join an ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified company and an ISTQB Platinum Partner.
Work remotely from anywhere within Egypt.
Receive a competitive salary based on your experience and technical expertise.
Gain hands-on exposure to business-critical production applications and complex technical environments.
Apply scripting, DevOps practices, and emerging AI-assisted tools to improve operational processes.
Expand your technical capabilities through practical challenges and exposure to different technologies.
Work with experienced engineering and operations professionals in a supportive, quality-focused environment.

freelance-technical-interviewer.title: Freelance Technical Interviewer
freelance-technical-interviewer.summary: Join FEKRA as a Freelance Technical Interviewer. Conduct remote technical assessments, evaluate engineering talent, and get paid per interview.
freelance-technical-interviewer.metaDescription: Join FEKRA as a Freelance Technical Interviewer. Conduct remote interviews, assess engineering talent, and submit reports. Paid per interview.
description: About the role
FEKRA is expanding its Technical Interviewing Team to support hiring operations across multiple engineering disciplines.
We are looking for experienced senior engineers who can conduct structured, fair, and insightful technical interviews to assess candidates' real-world engineering capabilities.

As a Freelance Technical Interviewer, you will evaluate candidates within your area of expertise, assess technical depth and problem-solving skills, and provide clear, objective evaluation reports to support our hiring decisions.
You only need expertise in
one or more technical domains
, not all of them.
Position details:
Location: 100% Remote — Worldwide
Engagement Type: Freelance
Compensation: Paid per interview
Interview Duration: 30–60 minutes
Experience Required: 6+ years
Language: Excellent English
Working Hours: Flexible, based on interview schedules
Start Date: Immediate
What you will do
Conduct structured 30–60 minute technical interviews remotely via video calls.
Assess candidates' practical technical knowledge, engineering experience, and problem-solving abilities.
Evaluate candidates across different seniority levels, including Junior, Mid-Level, Senior, and Principal.
Follow FEKRA's standardized technical interview framework and evaluation criteria.
Ask relevant technical, architectural, and scenario-based questions appropriate to each role.
Assess coding skills, debugging abilities, system design knowledge, and technical decision-making where relevant.
Identify technical strengths, knowledge gaps, and potential red flags.
Assess candidates' technical communication and ability to explain their decisions.
Prepare accurate, objective, and structured written evaluation reports after each interview.
Submit interview feedback within the agreed reporting timeframe.
Collaborate with FEKRA's recruitment team to maintain consistent and fair technical assessments.
Provide feedback and suggestions to continuously improve our interviewing process.
requirements: Technical domains we are hiring for
We are looking for interviewers with strong expertise in
one or more
of the following areas:
Backend Engineering:
Node.js, NestJS, Python, Django, Java, Spring Boot, PHP, Laravel, or similar technologies.
Frontend / Fullstack Engineering:
React, Angular, Vue.js, JavaScript, TypeScript, or related frameworks.
Data Science & Analytics:
Data Science, Product Analytics, Growth Analytics, Machine Learning, and related disciplines.
AI / Machine Learning:
LLMs, NLP, Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), AI applications, and MLOps fundamentals.
DevOps / Cloud / SRE:
AWS, Azure, CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, cloud infrastructure, and site reliability engineering.
WordPress / PHP Engineering:
WordPress, PHP, custom development, plugins, and performance optimization.
Mobile Engineering:
Flutter, iOS, Swift, Android, Kotlin, or related mobile technologies.
QA Automation:
Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, API testing, and automated testing frameworks.
Other Technical Domains:
Experienced engineers from other specializations are also welcome to apply.
What we are looking for
Required qualifications
6+ years of professional, hands-on engineering experience in at least one relevant technical domain.
Strong practical understanding of software engineering principles, architecture, debugging, and real-world technical challenges.
Ability to assess technical knowledge, code quality, engineering decisions, and problem-solving approaches.
Excellent English communication skills, both spoken and written.
Ability to conduct professional, structured, and objective technical interviews.
Strong analytical skills and the ability to distinguish theoretical knowledge from practical experience.
Ability to provide clear, detailed, and evidence-based technical evaluation reports.
Strong professional integrity, fairness, consistency, and confidentiality.
Ability to manage interview commitments and deliver feedback on time.
Comfortable working independently in a fully remote environment.
Preferred qualifications
Previous experience conducting technical interviews or participating in engineering hiring panels.
Experience interviewing candidates across different seniority levels.
Familiarity with live coding, system design, technical discussions, and scenario-based assessments.
Previous experience as a Senior Engineer, Tech Lead, Engineering Manager, or Technical Architect.
Experience mentoring engineers or evaluating technical competencies.
Familiarity with structured interview scorecards and competency-based evaluation frameworks.
What makes you successful
You can identify genuine technical expertise beyond what is written on a CV.
You ask thoughtful questions that reveal how candidates think, solve problems, and make engineering decisions.
You provide fair, consistent, and evidence-based assessments.
You communicate professionally and respectfully with candidates.
You take ownership of interview quality and deliver actionable evaluation reports.
You maintain confidentiality and uphold a high standard of professional integrity.
benefits: Conduct technical interviews based on your availability and scheduled interview opportunities.
Receive compensation for each completed interview under the agreed freelance arrangement.
Conduct interviews from anywhere in the world.
Put your technical knowledge and professional experience to valuable use by evaluating engineering talent.
Gain exposure to engineering roles, technologies, and technical challenges across different projects.
Work with FEKRA's recruitment and engineering teams through a structured interview and evaluation process.
Collaborate with an ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified company and ISTQB Platinum Partner.
Be considered for future technical interviews based on hiring needs, domain expertise, and availability.

senior-backend-engineer-nodejs-nestjs.title: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js / NestJS)
senior-backend-engineer-nodejs-nestjs.summary: Build secure, scalable Node.js and NestJS services for customer-facing digital products. Full-time, 6-month remote contract in Egypt.
senior-backend-engineer-nodejs-nestjs.metaTitle: Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js / NestJS) | FEKRA Jobs
senior-backend-engineer-nodejs-nestjs.metaDescription: Apply for a Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js / NestJS) role at FEKRA. Remote from Egypt, full-time 6-month contract, immediate start.
description: About the role
FEKRA is looking for a Senior Backend Engineer (Node.js / NestJS) to design, develop, and optimize scalable backend services supporting customer-facing digital products.

You will work on production-ready APIs, business logic, system integrations, and backend workflows that support web and mobile applications. The role requires strong technical ownership, a focus on performance and security, and close collaboration with cross-functional product and engineering teams.
Position details:
Location: 100% Remote — Egypt
Employment: Full-time contract
Contract Duration: 6 months
Experience: 5+ years
Start Date: Immediate
Working Days: Sunday to Thursday
Salary: Competitive, based on experience
What you will do
Design, develop, and maintain scalable backend services using Node.js, NestJS, and TypeScript.
Build secure, reliable, and maintainable RESTful APIs for web and mobile applications.
Implement backend business logic, transactional workflows, and third-party service integrations.
Collaborate with frontend, mobile, QA, and product teams to deliver production-ready features.
Optimize API response times, application performance, scalability, and system reliability.
Write clean, modular, well-structured, and testable code following established engineering standards.
Participate in architecture discussions, technical design decisions, and code reviews.
Troubleshoot production issues, investigate root causes, and improve system stability.
Work with relational databases, caching mechanisms, message queues, and background processing when required.
Apply backend security best practices, including authentication, authorization, and data validation.
Contribute to deployment workflows, monitoring, logging, and continuous improvement of backend systems.
requirements: What we are looking for
Required qualifications
5+ years of professional experience in backend software development.
Strong hands-on experience with Node.js and NestJS in production environments.
Strong proficiency in TypeScript.
Proven experience designing, developing, and maintaining RESTful APIs.
Solid understanding of backend architecture, modular design, and scalable application development.
Hands-on experience with relational databases such as PostgreSQL or MySQL.
Good understanding of authentication, authorization, input validation, and secure API design.
Experience integrating third-party services and external APIs.
Strong debugging, troubleshooting, and performance optimization skills.
Understanding of backend logging, monitoring, and observability.
Experience with Git and collaborative development workflows.
Ability to write clean, maintainable, and testable code.
Strong problem-solving skills, technical ownership, and the ability to work effectively with cross-functional teams.
Preferred qualifications
Experience in telecommunications, fintech, consumer digital products, or high-transaction environments.
Experience with microservices or service-oriented architectures.
Hands-on experience with Redis, message queues, or background job processing.
Familiarity with Docker and containerized applications.
Experience with CI/CD pipelines and modern deployment practices.
Familiarity with AWS, Azure, or similar cloud environments.
Experience supporting production systems through logging, monitoring, and incident troubleshooting.
Experience building systems that handle high traffic, real-time events, or large-scale user activity.
Previous experience collaborating with mobile, frontend, and product teams in fast-paced environments.
What makes you successful
A strong sense of ownership and responsibility for production systems.
A practical approach to building secure, scalable, and reliable backend solutions.
Attention to code quality, performance, and maintainable architecture.
The ability to communicate clearly and collaborate effectively with others.
A proactive mindset and the ability to deliver high-quality work within agreed timelines.
benefits: Join an ISO 9001 and ISO 27001 certified company and an ISTQB Platinum Partner.
Work remotely from anywhere within Egypt.
Receive a competitive salary based on your experience and technical expertise.
Contribute to real-world digital products and scalable backend systems.
Expand your technical expertise through challenging engineering work and continuous learning.
Work alongside experienced professionals in a supportive, quality-focused engineering environment.

internship-program.title: FEKRA Internship Program
internship-program.summary: Build real-world experience in software development, design, testing, AI, or business analysis.
description: About the program
FEKRA’s internship program is for passionate learners who want practical experience across software development, design, testing, AI, and business analysis.
You will contribute to real work, learn from experienced teammates, receive feedback, and build skills that transfer into a professional technology role.
requirements: What we are looking for
Students and recent graduates with a strong learning mindset, clear communication, and evidence of interest in their chosen technology or business discipline.
Include your university or major, graduation year, location, area of interest, and an up-to-date CV in your application.

business-development-specialist.title: Business Development Specialist
business-development-specialist.summary: Open new relationships with companies that need software outsourcing and remote engineering teams.
description: About the role
Join FEKRA’s growth team in a fully outbound role serving software outsourcing clients across Europe and the GCC.
What you will do
Identify relevant companies, research decision-makers, initiate thoughtful cold conversations, qualify outsourcing and team-augmentation needs, and turn strong opportunities into discovery calls.
requirements: What we are looking for
Real experience selling IT services, software outsourcing, or remote engineering teams and a track record of opening cold conversations.
Business-fluent English is mandatory. An additional European language is a strong advantage.

product-owner-qa.title: Product Owner / QA
product-owner-qa.summary: Shape product features and personally validate their quality across mobile and web releases.
description: About the role
This is a hands-on hybrid role combining product ownership with manual quality assurance for a fast-growing consumer technology product.
You will shape features, clarify requirements, work closely with design and engineering, and personally test mobile and web experiences before release. This is not a coordination-only role.
requirements: What we are looking for
6+ years of product, quality, or closely related delivery experience, with strong hands-on manual testing skills.
Deep product judgment, clear English communication, and comfort turning user and business needs into testable, release-ready work.

devops-engineer.title: Senior DevOps Engineer
devops-engineer.summary: Own CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, security, and reliable delivery for enterprise-level systems.
description: About the role
Join a dynamic engineering team to build and operate the cloud foundations, delivery pipelines, observability, and security controls behind production products.
What you will do
Design and improve CI/CD pipelines, cloud environments, infrastructure automation, monitoring, incident response, and practical security guardrails for enterprise delivery.
requirements: What we are looking for
Proven production DevOps experience across cloud platforms, CI/CD pipelines, containers, infrastructure as code, security, and enterprise projects.
Fluent English, a fully updated CV, and availability for full-time work aligned with the USA time zone.

ai-engineer.title: AI Engineer
ai-engineer.summary: Design, train, and deploy advanced AI systems for real-world products and production environments.
description: About the role
Join FEKRA’s engineering team to design, train, and deliver advanced AI and machine-learning solutions for real-world applications.
What you will do

Research and prototype deep-learning, NLP, LLM, and multimodal solutions; build scalable data and training workflows; collaborate with product and engineering teams; and support the full AI product lifecycle from ideation to production.
You will also help ensure responsible AI practices, including fairness, transparency, and bias reduction, while keeping current with the latest AI advances.
requirements: What we are looking for
5+ years of professional AI or machine-learning experience and a record of delivering AI systems in production.
Strong Python plus practical experience with PyTorch, TensorFlow, or JAX; NLP, LLM, or multimodal architectures; MLOps; distributed training; and AWS, GCP, or Azure AI services.
Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, data-engineering, deployment, and model-optimization skills.
benefits: Work remotely on modern fintech and cloud-based products with flexible work options, competitive pay, continuous learning, and a collaborative international team.
